title: General Availability: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29)
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29) is now generally available for cloud customers with version 29.0. New customers get the latest builds automatically, while existing customers receive email notifications when updates become available. On-premises release is pending.
key_points: BC29 (version 29.0) is generally available for cloud. The W1 build is platform 29.0.55365.0 with application 29.0.54011.55407
New SaaS customers get the latest builds automatically, and existing customers are told by email when updates are available to them
On-premises has not been released yet. The Modern Policy lifecycle entry for 29.x runs from Sep 30, 2026 to Apr 5, 2028
The post links to what's new videos, the release plan, a partner PowerPoint deck and office hours
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29) is generally available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the official GA date and availability status for new customers and updates

quotes.text: Existing customers will receive e-mail notifications when updates become available for them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the notification mechanism for current customer deployments
